items.rationale: A fixed AC unit is a building component under 4.2.2. Surge damage is covered as lightning overvoltage under 2.3.3, and this edition has no kitchen or hob exclusion, so a like-for-like replacement is indemnified under 7.1.1/7.1.9 at the customary rate of about 1413 per unit.
Installation is an ancillary charge that follows its principal item (7.1.11). If the replaced unit is covered, it is indemnified at about 480 per unit.
The console is an equivalent stand replacing the pre-existing support of a damaged unit, so it is part of the reinstatement (7.1.9 last paragraph). Indemnified at about 61.
Freight is an ancillary charge for a covered replacement unit and follows its principal item under 7.1.11. Indemnified at about 43.
